To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a fuzzy optimization approach is utilized to control the load of central air conditioning in wide area via internet over broadband networks for demand response.

fuzzy linear programming is utilized in the real time two way load control of central chillers in wide areas for demand response, and the constraints loosened through fuzzy inference system is defined by a fuzzy inference system, the minimum upper bound and the maximum lower bound of total load shed optimized are derived.

the proposed real time two way direct load control method for central air conditioning systems is able to shed a large amount of load at every sampling interval and the load shed is achieved with high accuracy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following: (1) A real time two-way control of central air-conditioning systems for demand response is developed.
the development and implementation of a real time two way demand response control for central air conditioning chill systems.
the following issues: (1) A real time two-way control system is designed and implemented for the central air conditioning system to participate in demand response.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
fuzzy optimization is a very effective tool to be used in the direct load control of central cooling systems in demand response program.
the proposed fuzzy linear programming approach is an effective optimization tool for the real time load shedding control.
the proposed approach is a real time, two way control of a large number of customers in a wide area for demand reduction in the central air conditioning systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a fuzzy linear programming approach to control central air conditioning chill in wide area for real time demand response is proposed and tested in real time.
a fuzzy linear programming is developed and utilized to solve the real time two way direct load control of central AC chillers.
the fuzzy optimization method proposed in this paper provides an effective way to control the load of central air conditioning in wide area.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed method can achieve the load shed required at every sampling interval with a very low computation cost.
the proposed approach is computationally efficient, robust and reliable for real time control of central air conditioners in wide area.
the proposed approach can be implemented as a two-way control system where customers can be informed of the load shed ratio and the load shed ratio can be adjusted by the customers.
